hero.eyebrow: 日本の先進インプラント技術
hero.title: AQB Implant System
hero.body: 日本で開発されたAQBインプラントシステムは、「Simple is Best.」の考え方に基づき、ワンピース構造と再結晶化ハイドロキシアパタイト表面を組み合わせたインプラントシステムです。
hero.concept2: 再結晶化ハイドロキシアパタイト表面

philosophy.title: Simple is Best.
philosophy.body1: AQB was developed around a straightforward clinical idea: implant treatment should respect the patient's existing anatomy and avoid unnecessary complexity wherever possible.
philosophy.body2: Rather than adding complexity to treatment, the AQB philosophy focuses on a simple implant design, preservation of existing bone, and a biologically focused clinical approach.

onePiece.title: One-Piece by Design
onePiece.body1: AQB integrates the implant body and abutment into a single one-piece structure.
onePiece.body2: This simple structural concept reflects the AQB philosophy of reducing unnecessary complexity while maintaining a clinically focused approach to implant treatment.
onePiece.item1Body: The implant body and abutment are integrated into a single design.
onePiece.item2Body: The one-piece structure expresses AQB's "Simple is Best" philosophy through a straightforward implant design.
onePiece.item3Body: The design is considered together with preservation of existing bone, biological integration, and appropriate clinical management.

surfaceTechnology.title: Re-crystallized Hydroxyapatite Surface
surfaceTechnology.body: AQB uses a hydroxyapatite (HA) surface that undergoes a re-crystallization process designed to create a biologically focused interface between the implant and surrounding bone.
surfaceTechnology.item1Body: Hydroxyapatite is a calcium phosphate material with a mineral composition related to that found in natural bone.
surfaceTechnology.item2Body: AQB's HA surface undergoes a re-crystallization process as part of its surface treatment, creating the characteristic surface structure of the implant.
surfaceTechnology.item3Body: The surface is designed to support the biological interaction that occurs at the interface between the implant and surrounding bone during healing.
surfaceTechnology.closing: For AQB, surface technology is not treated as an isolated feature. It forms part of a broader clinical philosophy centered on biology, existing bone, and appropriate clinical management.

existingBone.title: Respecting Existing Bone
existingBone.body1: AQB clinical philosophy places importance on making effective use of the patient's existing anatomy and preserving existing bone wherever clinically appropriate.
existingBone.body2: Rather than treating implant placement as an isolated mechanical procedure, treatment planning begins with understanding the available bone, surrounding anatomy, and the individual clinical situation.
existingBone.item1Body: Treatment planning begins with careful consideration of the patient's available bone and surrounding anatomical structures.
existingBone.item2Body: The clinical approach seeks to preserve and make effective use of existing bone wherever this is appropriate for the individual case.
existingBone.item3Body: The appropriate surgical and restorative approach depends on the patient's anatomy, bone condition, treatment plan, and professional clinical judgment.
existingBone.closing: Existing Bone Preservation is therefore a clinical philosophy - not a promise to avoid additional procedures in every case.

biologicalIntegration.title: Supporting the Bone–Implant Relationship
biologicalIntegration.body1: AQB's clinical concept considers biological integration as part of the relationship between the implant surface, surrounding bone, and appropriate clinical management.
biologicalIntegration.body2: The re-crystallized hydroxyapatite surface is designed to support the biological interaction at the bone–implant interface during healing. Clinical progress should always be evaluated according to the individual patient and treatment situation.
biologicalIntegration.item1Body: Biological integration develops at the interface between the implant surface and surrounding bone.
biologicalIntegration.item2Body: Integration should be understood as a biological healing process rather than a fixed or guaranteed timeline.
biologicalIntegration.item3Body: Healing and implant stability should be evaluated continuously according to the individual clinical situation.

occlusalAdjustment.title: Occlusal Adjustment Matters
occlusalAdjustment.body1: Successful implant treatment depends not only on implant design and biological integration, but also on appropriate clinical management after placement.
occlusalAdjustment.body2: In AQB clinical practice, careful occlusal adjustment is an important part of managing the forces applied to the implant and surrounding structures. Occlusion should be evaluated and adjusted according to the individual clinical situation.
occlusalAdjustment.item1Body: Evaluate the patient's occlusal condition as part of implant treatment and restorative planning.
occlusalAdjustment.item2Body: Occlusal contacts and functional loading should be carefully managed according to the healing stage and individual clinical situation.
occlusalAdjustment.item3Body: Occlusion should be reassessed during follow-up as part of the continuing clinical management of the implant.

maintenance.title: Maintenance Is Part of Implant Treatment
maintenance.body1: Implant treatment does not end with placement or restoration. Long-term clinical observation and regular maintenance are important parts of implant care.
maintenance.body2: Continued evaluation of the peri-implant tissues, oral hygiene, occlusion, and the overall clinical condition helps support the long-term management of the implant.
maintenance.item1Body: Periodic professional maintenance supports continued observation of the implant and surrounding tissues.
maintenance.item2Body: The condition of the tissues surrounding the implant should be monitored as part of long-term clinical care.
maintenance.item3Body: Occlusion, hygiene, tissue condition, and implant stability should continue to be evaluated over time.

naturalTooth.title: Treat the Implant as a Natural Tooth
naturalTooth.body1: AQB clinical philosophy emphasizes that an implant should not be considered an isolated device after treatment.
naturalTooth.body2: Like a natural tooth, it exists within a biological and functional environment and requires continued observation, appropriate occlusal management, oral hygiene, and professional maintenance.
naturalTooth.closing: Simple implant treatment is supported by careful diagnosis, respect for biology, appropriate clinical management, and long-term care.

keyFeatures.title: なぜAQBなのか
keyFeatures.feature1Description: AQBは、インプラント体とアバットメントを一体化したシンプルなワンピース構造です。
keyFeatures.feature2Title: 再結晶化ハイドロキシアパタイト表面
keyFeatures.feature2Description: インプラントと骨との生物学的結合を促すための特殊な表面処理です。
keyFeatures.feature3Description: 再結晶化ハイドロキシアパタイト表面により骨形成が促され、比較的早期（1～2か月）にインプラントと骨との強固な結合が形成されます。
